rule: D-LIB16-SIZE (lib-16-card ruling 9): every number a card does not give, each Mistake's magnitude included, fixed here before PQ-H3 is measured, each with its basis: a claim id, an approved plate's value (file:line on main 5158609c) used as a convention, or a stated physical reason. PQ-H3 is never a basis. A spec's exported SIZES table equals its row here (A17); a composer's exported constants equal theirs. Rows for ids not drawn yet are the note's proposals, ruled with 'LB6 NOTE RULED'.

STAGGER.basis: stated reason: c2 'one foot in front of the other': mid-soles two foot lengths (2 x 0.152 H) apart, the front heel about a foot length ahead of the rear toe

ROOT_DROP.basis: stated reason: the hips 6 cm below standing hip height, so both legs reach the floor in the stagger with soft knees (about 23 deg); the hips sit over the middle of the two ankles
